sections.title: PAYE: monthly scale
sections.basis: monthly taxable employment income (PAYE); the 25% band was removed by the 2025-26 mid-year measures, which the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement reports as in full effect

rows.label: PAYE: monthly withholding (mid-year measures in full effect)
rows.value: PAYE is withheld monthly on employment income at the rates of the monthly scale; the Minister reported on 27 February 2026 that the PAYE, VAT and transaction-levy measures of the 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget Statement are in full effect.

rows.label: Final withholding tax on residential rental income
rows.note: final withholding tax on residential rental income; commercial rental income stays under the existing withholding framework (Fourteenth Schedule to the Taxation Act). Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement (27 February 2026) to take effect on 1 April 2026, subject to Parliament's approval of the bills and assent; the enacted text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: Listed shares: final withholding tax on gross sale proceeds
rows.note: final withholding tax on the gross proceeds of sales of listed shares, deducted by the broker or the Malawi Stock Exchange; replaces capital gains tax on listed shares. Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement (27 February 2026) to take effect on 1 April 2026, subject to Parliament's approval of the bills and assent; the enacted text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: Corporate income tax: standard rate
rows.note: company profits below MWK 5 billion (standard corporate income tax rate).

rows.label: Supernormal profit tax (profits of MWK 5 billion and above)
rows.note: supernormal profit tax: company profits of MWK 5 billion and above (threshold reduced from MWK 10 billion). Under review: announced in the 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget Review Statement (21 November 2025); the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement confirms only the VAT, transaction levy and PAYE measures as in effect; the enacted Taxation (Amendment) Act text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: Minimum alternate tax (0.5% of turnover)
rows.note: minimum alternate tax on turnover, payable when higher than corporate income tax at 30%, for companies with turnover above MWK 5 billion operating for more than three years; excess creditable against future tax. Under review: announced in the 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget Review Statement (21 November 2025); the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement confirms only the VAT, transaction levy and PAYE measures as in effect; the enacted Taxation (Amendment) Act text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: VAT registration threshold
rows.note: annual turnover above which VAT registration and the electronic invoicing system (EIS) are compulsory; raised from MWK 25 million. Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement (27 February 2026) to take effect on 1 April 2026, subject to Parliament's approval of the bills and assent; the enacted text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: VAT standard rate
rows.note: standard VAT rate, raised from 16.5% by the 2025-26 mid-year measures (reported in full effect in February 2026).

rows.label: Excise on powdered soft-drink flavours
rows.note: excise tax on powdered soft-drink flavours sold in sachets (customs and excise measures effective from midnight on the day of the statement). Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement as a customs and excise measure effective from midnight on 27 February 2026; the customs and excise order was not found on an official site.

rows.label: Excise on hybrid vehicles of 1,501 to 2,500 cc (20% above 2,500 cc)
rows.note: excise tax on hybrid motor vehicles of 1,501 to 2,500 cc (20% from 2,501 cc); fully electric vehicles stay exempt. Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement as a customs and excise measure effective from midnight on 27 February 2026; the customs and excise order was not found on an official site.

sections.title: Securities, insurance and digital services taxes

rows.label: VAT on digital services supplied by foreign companies
rows.value: VAT is extended to digital services supplied over the internet by foreign companies (streaming, social media advertising, software and apps) from 1 April 2026; the operating rules are set in a bill.
rows.note: Under review: announced in the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement (27 February 2026) to take effect on 1 April 2026, subject to Parliament's approval of the bills and assent; the enacted text was not found on an official site.

rows.label: Bank transfer levy
rows.note: levy on all bank transfers within or across banks, paid by the sender (not on transfers of Government funds to or from the Reserve Bank of Malawi); not deductible for income tax.

rows.label: Mobile money transfer levy (transfers above MWK 100,000)
rows.note: levy on the amount of mobile money transfers above MWK 100,000, paid by the sender.

rows.label: Motor vehicle insurance accident levy
rows.note: Motor Vehicle Accident Fund levy on motor vehicle insurance, ring-fenced for the Ministry of Health; collection assigned to the Malawi Revenue Authority from 2026-27. Under review: announced in the 2025-26 Mid-Year Budget Review Statement (21 November 2025); the 2026-27 Budget Policy Statement confirms only the VAT, transaction levy and PAYE measures as in effect; the enacted Taxation (Amendment) Act text was not found on an official site.
